_fixture: Invented plugin-rack fixtures for the design prototype (Documents 03 §7, 15 §6, 19 §4 'system'). No plugin was discovered, validated, loaded or measured: latency, CPU budget, ABI, versions, vendors and failure text are drawn to exercise <mdj-plugin-slot> states. Formats named here (AAP, an app-native module interface, VST3) describe what the real host would print; nothing certifies that any of them is supported. Desktop binaries are never assumed Android-compatible.

process.label: Process boundary
process.detail: Runs in a separate process over shared memory at a fixed declared latency; the audio callback never waits for it. A crash stops this plugin only.

in-process.label: In-process · trusted
in-process.detail: Runs with the host's privileges and can crash it. Not sandboxed, and never labelled as such.

plugins.name: Glassverb

plugins.name: Brass Keys
plugins.note: Instrument fault behaviour: short controlled mute, never a stale block repeated.

plugins.name: Tide Compressor
plugins.failure: Missed the processing deadline in 3 of 2000 validation blocks and declared a state schema (v2) the host cannot read. Not loadable until the vendor ships a fix.

plugins.name: DesktopChorus.vst3
plugins.failure: A desktop VST3 binary. Android is not in the VST3 SDK's supported-platform table and this file targets another CPU and operating system; it cannot be made compatible automatically.

plugins.name: Phaser Nine
plugins.failure: Saved with this session but not installed on this device. The slot is kept as a placeholder with its saved state (preset 'Slow sweep', 412 bytes); it is not replaced by a different effect.
